verdict.rationale: Alacritty has a programmatic surface: IPC via `alacritty msg`. A machine-readable spec for that interface is therefore a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no OpenAPI or equivalent schema, and probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths on alacritty.org all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
